title: Brazilian Bread Cookies
description: A sweet treat inspired by Brazilian flavors, these cookies are a perfect combination of crunchy and chewy.
instructions: 2. In a large mixing bowl, cream together the sugar and melted butter until light and fluffy.
3. Beat in the eggs and vanilla extract.
4. Stir in the crushed cookies and cubed bread.
5. Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of the dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden.
7. Remove from the oven and let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
